title: Ancient Wisdom, Modern Pressure: Mohanji In Conversation At Princeton University
description: Spiritual teacher leader and humanitarian Mohanji told an audience at Princeton University on 2 October that success means contentment, and that much of the stress people experience comes from believing they own things.

title: 700,000-Year-Old Elephant Tooth Reveals Ancient Oasis Where Early Humans Survived
description: A 700,000-year-old elephant tooth found in northern Israel reveals how a water-rich landscape may have supported giant animals and early humans.

title: Archaeologists Just Found 226 Human Teeth in an Ancient Maya Burial Cave
description: A Maya woman who was buried in a cave in southern Belize sometime between 250 and 400 CE was so revered, according to researchers, that people have been visiting her gravesite for centuries, leaving offerings, and one of the most popular offerings is teeth. 226 human teeth, to be exact. title: What Are Ancient Grains?
description: What are ancient grains? The most nutritious whole grains have been unaltered since their domestication. Add nutrition to your plate by growing them in your garden.

title: Ancient Martian Meteorite Found in the Sahara Desert May Have Formed More Than 4.1 Billion Years Ago
description: Learn about Teghaza 001, a meteorite from Mars over 4.1 billion years old that contains many minerals that could shed light on the planet's crust.
